rulesNotes: Resulting Materia depends on both Fusion Classes AND the highest Grade (1–8) between the two Materia (Mastered Materia each add +1 Grade, up to +2!).
Consumables (Potion, Hi-Potion, X-Potion, Ether, Soma, Elixir) ONLY amplify an existing matching stat bonus on one of the fused Materia. On two +0 Materia they add +0.
Mako Stones add +1 per 5 stones (max +40) or +10% per 5 stones (max +400%).
Stat Stones add +1 per 3 stones (max +66) or +10% per 3 stones (max +660%).
Max-tier fusion items (Hero Drink, Adamantite, Dark Matter, Mythril, Gysahl Greens, Fat Chocobo Feather, Lunar Harp, Zeio Nut) add +1 (max +100) or +10% (max +999%) per item.
When building a Libra transfer Materia, stop at +98 (or +980% HP) so it remains open to item conversion during final fusion.

specialOverrides.note: Any Punch Materia (Goblin Punch / Iron Fist / Magical Punch / Hammer Punch) + ANY DMW Materia = Costly Punch!
High Jump + Drain / Osmose / Assault Twister = Aerial Drain (i-frames + full heal).
Barrier + MBarrier = Wall (applies both buffs in one cast).
Graviga + Darkness / Assault Twister+ = Quake (wide screen AoE).
Firaga + Status Strike (or Poison/Silence/Stop) = Hell Firaga.
Blizzaga + Status Strike (or Poison/Silence/Stop) = Hell Blizzaga.
Thundaga + Status Strike (or Poison/Silence/Stop) = Hell Thundaga.
High-grade Ultimate Magic (Flare / Energy / Tri-Thundaga) + DMW Materia = Ultima.
Dualcast can be bought directly from Online Shop Shade (M9-5-4, 30,000 Gil) or fused from high-grade Magic + LCK/Dash chains.
Steal + Mastered Assault Twister / Vital Slash = Mug.
